name: c10-pass1
description: C10 family coverage for model pass 1: RC11's recipe (rc11-pass1) with the hot slot's RC8/RC9 Winograd sequence also on the 1080p-family slot 0x2cce40 (context maximum <= 1920x1080, 960x540 grid) and the 8K-family slot 0x4bee10 (context maximum 7680x4320, 3840x2160 grid). The hot slot 0x7de1d0 and the other three slots are unchanged from RC11. `expected` pins the two new programs; they compute RC11's (and the SDK's) integers bit for bit (dll/port/equivalence.py prove).
